59fb05b69c.q: What is Floyd Lee Locums' business model and how does the company operate in the healthcare staffing industry?
59fb05b69c.a: Floyd Lee Locums is a healthcare staffing company that places doctors in hospitals across the country where they are critically needed, allowing the company to show up every day and make healthcare a little bit better. The company focuses on positioning physicians in ways that play to their career growth while helping facilities gain ultimate flexibility in coverage.

c42d30bc11.q: How did Floyd Lee Locums solve a critical healthcare access issue in rural North Carolina through locum tenens staffing?
c42d30bc11.a: Floyd Lee Locums placed an oncologist seeking flexibility in the Outer Banks area of North Carolina with an arrangement of one week in person, two weeks via telehealth, and one week off. This creative scheduling allowed him to help build an oncology program for a four-county rural area where patients previously had to drive three hours to receive oncology care.
